title: Symmetry-Averaged Query Probabilities
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be invariant under a transitive group of coordinate permutations, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree computing $f$. For any probability distribution $\pi$ on $\{-1,1\}$ and any coordinates $i,j$, the averages over the uniform distribution on the permutation group preserving $f$ of the probability that $T$ queries the permuted coordinate $\sigma^{-1}(i)$ and the probability that it queries $\sigma^{-1}(j)$, in each case for an input drawn from the product distribution with marginal $\pi$, are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a randomized decision tree on sign-valued inputs and outputs, computing $f$ for every seed
$\pi$ is a probability distribution on the sign alphabet
$f$ is invariant under a transitive group of coordinate permutations
$i$ and $j$ are coordinates among the $n$ input coordinates
